sentences.text:
Sri Pijus Ghosh vs The State Of West Bengal & Others on 23
March, 2023

Author: Rajasekhar Mantha
Bench: Rajasekhar Mantha

23.03.2023
Item No.23
Court No.13.
 Ab
 Wpa No. 1880 of 2023
 Sri Pijus Ghosh
 Vs
 The State of West Bengal & Others
 Mr. Ranojoy Chatterjee,
 Mr. Subhojyoti Hader ...for the Petitioner.
 Mr. Debashis Ghosh,
 Mr. Debapriya Chatterjee......for the State.
 Affidavit of Service filed in Court today be kept
 on record.
The petitioner complains of inaction by the  Shibpur Police Station in connection with first  information report no.406 of 2022 dated 7.12.2022  under Sections 420/406 IPC.
The petitioner's grievance is that the private  respondent obtained Rs.15 Lacs on the promise of getting a job for the petitioner's brother.
The petitioner was a married man and was also living in with the private respondent.
Counsel for the State submits that the petitioner himself is facing trial in connection with charge sheet no.707 dated 18.10.2020 under Sections 417/376/ 420/506/34 IPC.
The State submits that the subject first information report is most likely a counter blast to the complaint, which is being tested in trial against him.
